Implementation complete.

**Changed paths** (exactly the three permitted source files; `visible-test.mjs` untouched, no other files created):
- `parse.mjs` — `parseJobs(text)`: TypeError on non-string; strips a leading BOM only; splits LF/CRLF with physical 1-based line numbers; ignores blank (empty/whitespace-only) lines; validates non-null non-array objects with `id` (1–32 ASCII `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`), finite nonnegative integer `durationMs`, and the three statuses; emits normalized records with only `{id, durationMs, status}`; errors are `{line, code}` with string codes, classified INVALID_JSON → SCHEMA → DUPLICATE_ID, schema checks preceding duplicate detection; invalid records never reserve ids; first valid record per id kept in input order; no raw input in errors.
- `aggregate.mjs` — `summarizeJobs(jobs)`: counts every job, sums duration for succeeded/failed only, success-only median (arithmetic mean of the middle pair computed as `a/2 + b/2` to avoid overflow, `0` when none), top-three non-skipped by duration desc then ASCII id asc; operates on shallow-copied jobs and a sorted copy — input array/objects never mutated; empty input yields zero counters and empty `slowest`.
- `cli.mjs` — exactly two args; rejects `resolve(INPUT) === resolve(OUTPUT)` before any file change; reads INPUT fully as UTF-8 first (read failure exits 1, existing OUTPUT preserved); publishes `JSON.stringify({summary, errors}, null, 2) + '\n'` via recursive parent mkdir, exclusive uniquely named sibling temp (`'wx'`, retried on EEXIST), write/close, then atomic `rename` onto OUTPUT — never pre-deleting or truncating existing output; cleans up only owned temp files on failure; constant sanitized stderr messages only, no stdout output, no report/raw data leakage; exits 0 on clean input (incl. empty file), 2 when parser errors exist despite publishing the valid-record report, 1 on argument/read/write failures.

**Actual visible-test result:** `node visible-test.mjs` → `3 visible assertions passed`, exit code 0, on the first run. No product defect was reported, so per the contract no rerun was performed and none of the requirements were weakened. No sandbox/EPERM block occurred (the test performs no child-process capture), so no blocked check needs external execution.

**Unresolved product defects:** none known — the scoped self-test passed; parser edge cases and CLI failure/publication behavior await the environment owner's independent integration verification.
